title: Fenced code blocks and long tool schemas
why: Source code and JSON tool schemas are dense in punctuation, indentation runs and repeated keys — exactly the region of a BPE merge table that changes most between tokenizer releases, and the region where a whitespace-run merge revision would silently shift every number in `ctxdiff tokens`. The fixture also registers a tool that is never invoked so the schema-bloat detector (which reports both a token cost and a percentage) is on the compared surface.
